seo_title: Constructor Group Case Study: Calcularis Content | SOMIN
description: SOMIN analysed 8,971 posts and ads from 10 education brands for Constructor Group's Calcularis and found maths engagement the most underrepresented theme.
eyebrow: Brand case study · Education technology · Maths learning
h1: Constructor's Calcularis talks growth, but maths engagement is the gap
h1_em: but maths engagement is the gap
lede: Calcularis, from Constructor Group, shares a content space with maths-learning brands such as IXL, Prodigy Education and KooBits. SOMIN analysed 8,971 pieces of media from 10 brands: 4,663 paid ads from six months and 4,308 organic posts from four years. It found Calcularis focused on intellectual growth, while engagement was the most underrepresented maths-education problem.
meta_line: A SOMIN brand briefing · 4 years organic, 6 months paid · 10 education brands

challenge.title: Where Constructor's Calcularis sits among 10 education brands
challenge.body: Calcularis, from Constructor Group, shares a content space with maths-learning brands such as IXL, Prodigy Education, DoodleLearning, KooBits and XtraMath. The question was how these brands address education in their content, where Calcularis focuses, and which maths-learning problems are underrepresented.

approach.title: Automated theme detection across 8,971 posts and ads
points: Labelled content with SOMIN's content concept framework, adding education fields such as promoted subject and key stage of education.
Ran automated theme detection (X-means clustering on ADA embeddings) across 8,971 posts and ads from 10 brands.
Mapped each brand's share of every theme to see where Calcularis focuses.
Re-clustered the maths education theme into four problem themes and explored the psychological reasons behind the most underrepresented one.
Turned those reasons into illustrated stories with SOMIN's Story Explorer.

findings_title: Growth leads Calcularis' comms, engagement is underrepresented

findings.title: Intellectual growth is Calcularis' main theme, at 494 posts
findings.body: Continuous Learning and Intellectual Growth is Calcularis' main focus in comms. At 494 posts, it is also the largest of the 10 themes detected.

findings.title: Maths education is a smaller theme, at 236 posts
findings.body: Importance of Mathematics Education and Strategies for Success held 236 posts. SOMIN drilled into it because Constructor Group mentioned maths as a talking point.

findings.title: Engagement, at 73 posts, is the most underrepresented
findings.body: Of four problem themes in maths education, Lack of Engagement and Effectiveness in Math Education, covering 73 posts, is the most underrepresented.

delivered.title: Ten content themes, four maths problem themes and three stories
points: A content concept framework adapted for educational content, with strict, long-form, short-form and sparse labels.
Ten automated content themes with post counts and a brand-by-brand split.
Four problem themes within maths education, with the most underrepresented one flagged.
The psychological reasons behind disengagement, from fear of failure and limited autonomy to negative peer influence.
Three illustrated Story Explorer stories, including A Mother's Tale of Math Missteps and Breaking Free from Peer Pressure: My Math Odyssey.

quote.text: Mistakes are not setbacks but stepping stones; they teach us that imperfection is the heart of growth.

outcome.title: Constructor's Calcularis can speak to disengaged maths learners
outcome.body: Engagement is the most underrepresented problem in maths education content. SOMIN's stories show routes into it through fear of failure, autonomy and peer support, giving Calcularis a way to reach disengaged learners and their parents beyond its intellectual-growth message.

faq.a: Buzzmath.com, Constructor Group, DoodleLearning, ExploreLearning Reflex, IXL, KooBits, Matific, Prodigy Education, Synthesis and XtraMath.
SOMIN used automated theme detection with X-means clustering on ADA embeddings: two initial centres for the full set and four for the maths subset, each with a maximum of 10 clusters.
It helps people understand the data and build more potent insights. Selected concepts, the identified theme and psychological factors form a story template that an LLM expands into a narrative.
